WITH matches AS (
  SELECT c.call_id, n.temp_stop, n.notice_id, f.record_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.call_id ORDER BY n.notice_id COLLATE BINARY, f.record_id COLLATE BINARY) AS choice
  FROM planned_call AS c
  JOIN dispatch_notice AS n ON n.plan_stop = c.plan_stop
    AND c.plan_min >= n.first_min
    AND (n.last_min IS NULL OR c.plan_min < n.last_min)
  JOIN field_record AS f ON f.call_id = c.call_id
    AND f.seen_stop = n.temp_stop AND f.event_code = 'BOARD'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM field_record AS s
    WHERE s.call_id = c.call_id AND s.seen_stop = c.plan_stop AND s.event_code = 'BOARD'
  )
)
SELECT call_id, temp_stop, notice_id, record_id FROM matches WHERE choice = 1 ORDER BY call_id

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY flow_code ORDER BY rev_no DESC) AS choice
  FROM flow_revision WHERE record_day <= 8
), balances AS (
  SELECT account_code, ccy, SUM(signed_minor) AS pay_minor
  FROM ranked WHERE choice = 1 AND state_code = 'live'
  GROUP BY account_code, ccy HAVING SUM(signed_minor) > 0
)
SELECT 'account,ccy,pay_minor' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_text
FROM (
  SELECT account_code || ',' || ccy || ',' || pay_minor || char(10) AS line
  FROM balances ORDER BY account_code COLLATE BINARY, ccy COLLATE BINARY
)

  SELECT '"' || replace(g.gate_tag, '"', '""') || '",' || (r.scan_crates - g.beam_crates) || char(10) AS line

)
